examShortTricks: Trick 1: Globalisation answers need BOTH faces: opportunity (trade, technology, jobs) and threat (cultural erosion, inequality) — one-sided answers sit in the middle band.
Trick 2: Diaspora questions revolve around identity — 'neither fully here nor there'; use the words displacement, nostalgia, hybrid identity.
Trick 3: Bring the answer home: remittance economy and brain drain are Nepal's two lived dimensions of this theme.
practiceQuestions: Q. Give two effects of globalisation on local culture. (2 marks) — spread of global media erodes local language/dress; but also revives interest through global audiences.
Q. What challenges do diaspora communities face? (2 marks) — identity conflict and discrimination; loss of language across generations.
keyPoints: Globalization brings both opportunity and cultural loss — mention both effects.
Diaspora themes: identity, nostalgia, belonging; use these three keywords.
